Marta Kim: Hey team! I'm Marta — just started today on Platform. Small thing: I collect pocket calculators (yes, classic HPs and a few Soviet ones). If anyone has a weird desk trinket or tiny gadget swap, I'm game. Also planning to grab coffee at 11:30 in the SF kitchen for quick intro — all welcome! :wave:
Juno Park: welcome! love a good niche collection :eyes: 11:30 works for me
Avery Li: Hi Marta — welcome aboard :tada: I'm at D3; will swing by. Also curious which HPs you have.
Sam Rizzo: welcome! there's a 'desk curios' shelf near the rooftop—leave one there and I'll post pics :camera_flash: 
Marta Kim: Yay thanks! I brought an HP-12C (financial), an old Casio fx-7000G, and a funky Elektronika. I'll drop one on the shelf.
welcome-bot: Marta Kim joined #new-hires (account created).
Juno Park: Also, if you want a tiny table for displays, talk to Facilities — they're usually OK. cc @Facilities :mag: 
Avery Li: PSA — kitchen coffee machine is acting up this week, bring a mug with a lid :coffee: :grimacing: 
Sam Rizzo: @Marta Kim if you can, bring the HP-12C for the team show-and-tell. My dad collects slide rules so this will be a match made in analog :thumbsup: 
Marta Kim: Will do! See you all at 11:30. Thanks for the warm welcome :blush:
